description: This file contains functions for platform-specific upgrade procedures for a system, including device identification, configuration backup, and upgrade operations for various hardware configurations.

methods.name: platform_get_rootfs_device
methods.description: Determines the root filesystem device by parsing mount info and resolving symlinks.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_sdboot
methods.description: Backs up configuration to an SD card by mounting the appropriate partition and copying files.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_sdboot
methods.description: Performs system upgrade by writing kernel and root filesystem to appropriate partitions from a tar archive.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_nor
methods.description: Performs upgrade directly into NOR flash by combining kernel and root filesystem into a single image.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Verifies the compatibility of a firmware image with the current hardware.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies system configuration files based on hardware type.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade function that delegates to specific upgrade functions based on hardware.
